translations.web: Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”
translations.bsb: The LORD God also said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make for him a suitable helper.”
translations.kjv: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.
translations.asv: And Jehovah God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a help meet for him.
